# Threat model: super-agent (agentcore-superagent-update)

## Overview
Multi-tenant "Super Agent Platform": Fastify+Prisma backend (`super-agent/backend`), agentcore runtime, React frontend, infra. Product surface is the backend HTTP API. Assessment was white-box, local-only (mocked Prisma / Fastify inject / vitest PoCs; no deployed endpoints, real credentials, or cloud resources contacted).

Main components:
- `backend/src/middleware/auth.ts` — `authenticate` hook: internal HMAC token OR local JWT OR Cognito verifier; `requireRole` RBAC.
- `backend/src/authorization/` + `middleware/scopeAccess.ts` / `agentAccess.ts` — permission, scope, and agent access control.
- `backend/src/services/widget-auth.service.ts` — SHA-256 API-key auth for widget routes (audited clean).
- ~50 route files under `backend/src/routes/`; WebSocket gateway `src/websocket/execution.gateway.ts`; IM webhook in `src/routes/im.routes.ts`.

## Trust Boundaries and Assumptions
- Unauthenticated internet caller → backend API. Public mutating surfaces found and confirmed: `POST /api/im/webhook/:bindingId` (no signature) and `/ws/executions` (no auth).
- Authenticated end user (roles owner/admin/member/viewer) → authenticated routes.
- Agent subprocess → API via `internal.<base64url>.<HMAC>` token, 1h expiry; HMAC key is `jwtSecret` (local mode) or the **public** `userPoolId` (cognito mode) — forged-token path confirmed by PoC.
- Tenant boundary (`orgId`/memberships/business scopes) is enforced per-route and is inconsistent — several org-unbound or user-unbound queries confirmed.

## Attack Surface and Attacker Stories (confirmed this scan)
| Who | Path | Impact | Report |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unauthenticated | Forge internal token using public userPoolId (leaked via `GET /api/auth/config`) | Auth as any user/role/org, no profile lookup | vuln-0003 (critical) |
| Unauthenticated | `POST /api/im/webhook/:bindingId` | Arbitrary agent execution in victim org, session creation, IM channel injection, reply returned; ID enumeration | vuln-0007 (medium) |
| Unauthenticated | `/ws/executions` subscribe to any executionId | Cross-org workflow events incl. node logs/outputs (static trace) | vuln-0010 (medium) |
| Unauthenticated (local mode, JWT_SECRET unset) | Forge JWT with hardcoded default secret | Full auth bypass + role forgery | vuln-0001 (high) |
| Authenticated member | `agent_permissions` rows keyed (agent_id,user_id) with no org binding; `:permId` update/delete by id | Cross-org agent admin | vuln-0004 (high) |
| Authenticated member | Chat sessions/history filtered by org but not user | Read other members' chats | vuln-0006 (medium) |
| Any | Hardcoded default `INSFORGE_JWT_SECRET` used to mint access tokens | Forged InsForge tokens | vuln-0008 (high) |
| Any | `?token=` session JWT in URLs (frontend embeds it) | Token leakage | vuln-0005 (low) |
| Any | Scope-membership routes mutate `membershipId` unbound to authorized scope | Cross-scope membership manipulation | vuln-0002 (medium) |

Dependency CVEs with reachability verdicts filed separately (js-yaml, nodemailer, fastify, ws — vuln-0009/0011/0012/0013).

Unrealistic in scope: contacting deployed AWS/Cognito resources, attacks requiring real credentials — validation was local-only per engagement rules.

## Severity Calibration
- Critical: unauthenticated full auth bypass (vuln-0003).
- High: cross-org admin, default-secret JWT forgery, framework-level CVE on all requests.
- Medium: unauthenticated agent execution via webhook, cross-org event subscription, member-level IDOR within org, dependency CVEs with confirmed reachable paths.
- Low/Info: token-in-URL, non-reachable dependency CVEs.
